name: install-and-validate-test-extension
description: Single-shot end-to-end test agent. In a throwaway temp repo (fixture-based), it installs the harness core, drives the add-extension skill to author a new `harness <verb>` extension, then independently validates that the extension loads (`doctor`), lists (`help`), and runs with the expected Envelope status/exit. Reports a structured verdict plus a magic-wand retrospective for both the project and minih.
author: AI-Substrate

files.description: Mission: temp-repo setup, harness install, skill-driven extension authoring, independent validation, verdict + retrospective. Documents how skills are wired into minih (`.minih.json` skills block / `--skill-source`+`--skill`).
Rules: drive the skill (don't bypass it), independent verification is mandatory, prefer --json, throwaway-only writes, capture friction at the moment of friction.
Structured report: tempRepo, installResult, scaffoldResult, validation, verdict (PASS|FAIL), summary, and retrospective (workedWell/confusing/magicWand/magicWandTarget/difficulties).
Minimal fixture repo copied into the temp dir; exposes an `npm run demo` script for the --wrap variant.
Explains the fixture: a clean repo with no .harness/ folder, proving extension-from-zero.
